recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current FHIR source is correct for FHIR-26591; any future changes to the example terminology should be handled by a new Patient Care tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-26591 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification change request asking to replace the broad Goal.description value set with a smaller example set of SNOMED CT concepts that better represent desired objectives of care.
initial_application: Commit b04538a53a1926baaa4fc65b4484f0ecd1f8bc7e changed Goal.description from ValueSet/clinical-findings to ValueSet/goal-description and added source/goal/valueset-goal-description.xml. Later maintenance changed metadata/status formatting but preserved the curated concept list.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini. The linked Zulip thread records the original concern that broad clinical findings could be confused with goals, and Confluence/Jira records show Patient Care revisited and voted the curated example set in 2023. No searched community evidence contradicted the applied decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml already binds Goal.description to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/goal-description and source/goal/valueset-goal-description.xml contains the ten final resolution concepts.
